meta.prompt: Compare two phone plans side by side for me: price, data, calls, roaming, contract length and extras, with the better value on each row marked, a recommendation at the bottom with one sentence of reasoning, and a choose button under each plan that tells you which I picked.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Compare phone plans" "Two plans, side by side" icon:"smartphone" w:390
  ComparisonTable names:["Lite","Max"] prices:["$20/mo","$35/mo"] pick:"Max" pickLabel:"Best value" cta:"Choose" corner:"Plan" rows:[["Price","$20","$35",1],["Data","10 GB","Unlimited",2],["Calls","300 min","Unlimited",2],["Roaming","EU only","EU + US",2],["Contract","12 months","Monthly",2],["Extras","None","Streaming + eSIM",2]] -> toast "You picked {result}"; emit choosePlan result
  Recommendation "Max is the better value" "For $15 more you get unlimited data and calls, wider roaming and no lock-in." eyebrow:"Recommended"
